purpose: Read-only source discovery and public map/service review for the exact ranked city record; no globals/runtime/catalog integration.
assessment: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. Official Ministry sources confirm a Nineveh/Mosul-area registration directorate, but public deed/map e-services are limited to selected Baghdad directorates and require owner documentation. The official reconstruction GIS is project/facility mapping, not a cadastre. No anonymous city parcel layer or parcel geometry was found; no private data or credentials were used.
registryAssessment: The Iraqi Ministry of Justice lists the Nineveh Real Estate Registration Directorate (including al-Zuhoor) as a local property-registration office. The Ministry’s electronic deed/map services are described as rolled out in selected Baghdad directorates, and the official service workflow requires owner documents; this does not establish a public parcel-map service for Mosul.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry directory lists the Nineveh Real Estate Registration Directorate / al-Zuhoor office.
Official Ministry notice describes e-services for deed and parcel-map requests and names the currently participating Baghdad directorates; the announcement does not include Nineveh.
Government project GIS for Nineveh concerns reconstruction projects/facilities, not cadastral parcels.
